links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of two LLMs versus expert clinical diagnosis on same audiogram data
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o accuracy 60.8% (kappa 0.578) vs Gemini 1.5 Pro 86.1% (kappa 0.848); Gemini significantly higher, showing candidate performance differs on the same data.
links.quote: The findings suggest that Gemini 1.5 Pro demonstrated stronger performance, achieving an accuracy of 86.1%, whereas ChatGPT-4o achieved 60.8% in interpreting real-world pure-tone audiograms.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Pro on structured audiogram data retrospectively compared to expert diagnoses, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
